software_update.description: Problems or questions related to iOS/software updates, including failed updates, bugs after updates, version-specific issues, and update workarounds.
examples: My iPhone started freezing after the new iOS update
The latest update broke my keyboard
Which iOS version should I install?

device_troubleshooting.description: Problems with Apple devices such as iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch, including freezing, restarting, shutting down, screen, camera, speaker, or other device behavior.
examples: My iPhone keeps shutting down
Apple Watch keeps restarting
My phone screen is frozen

battery_power.description: Battery drain, battery health, charging, power consumption, overheating related to battery or power behavior.
examples: My battery drains very quickly
How can I check my battery health?
My phone won't stay charged
My iPhone gets hot and loses battery quickly

connectivity.description: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular, roaming, or other device connectivity problems.
examples: Bluetooth won't connect to my car
My iPhone won't connect to Wi-Fi
Cellular data stopped working

apple_music_media.description: Apple Music and media-library issues, including playback, missing music, downloads, and music synchronization.
examples: My Apple Music library disappeared
Songs won't play
My downloaded music disappeared after the update

account_security.description: Apple ID/account access, password, verification, security, phishing, or suspicious-account activity.
examples: I can't verify my Apple account
I forgot my Apple ID password
I received a suspicious Apple message

purchase_store_refund.description: Apple Store purchases, returns, refunds, sales support, and purchase-related issues.
examples: I want to return my purchase
Where is my refund?
I need help with something I bought from the Apple Store

app_service_issue.description: Problems with a specific app, Apple service, or third-party service interaction where the issue is not primarily device, account, connectivity, or update related.
examples: Spotify isn't working on my iPhone
This app keeps crashing
A service stopped working after the update

how_to_settings.description: Questions asking how to configure a setting, enable/disable a feature, or follow an Apple-supported procedure.
examples: How do I change this setting?
Where can I find my iOS version?
How do I enable iCloud Music Library?

general_or_insufficient_context.description: Messages that cannot be reliably assigned to a specific support issue without additional context, including vague requests, acknowledgements, and conversational replies.
examples: I need help
Yes
Thanks
Please help
